before: In a piece judged moment by moment (a scene, a brief, a night on stage), how well you hold up in its later moments, more the longer the piece and the more physical and vocal work it asks; on a night, how much its workload asks (the production’s running time, your part’s share of it and how intense it is), with less strain just after an interval; the energy a night costs you afterward, up to half of it spared at full stamina; and in work shown whole, without a scene (voice work, a song, movement, a fight), your consistency.
after: How well you hold up through the later moments of a piece judged moment by moment (a scene, a brief, a night on stage), more the longer the piece and the more physical and vocal work it asks. On a night, how much it’s asked depends on the workload: the production’s running time, your part’s share of it and how intense it is, with less strain just after an interval. At full stamina it spares up to half the energy a night costs you afterward. In work shown whole, without a scene (voice work, a song, movement, a fight), it keeps you consistent.

after: How much you gain from classes, nights on stage, preparation and practice: a tenth more with discipline at 100 and a tenth less at 0 (but not the fitness a workout builds).
